arxiv-1604-08863.title: A Novel Third Order Numerical Method for Solving Volterra Integro-Differential Equations
arxiv-1604-08863.description: Abstract In this paper we introduce a numerical method for solving nonlinear Volterra integro-differential equations. In the first step, we apply implicit trapezium rule to discretize the integral in given equation. Further, the Daftardar-Gejji and Jafari technique (DJM) is used to find the unknown term on the right side. We derive existence-uniqueness theorem for such equations by using Lipschitz condition.

arxiv-2011-13196.title: Mesoscopic quantum superposition states of weakly-coupled matter-wave solitons
arxiv-2011-13196.creator: Dmitriy Tsarev, Alexander Alodjants, The Vinh Ngo, Ray-Kuang Lee
arxiv-2011-13196.description: Abstract The Josephson junctions (JJs) are at the heart of modern quantum technologies and metrology. In this work we establish quantum features of an atomic soliton Josephson junction (SJJ) device, which consists of two weakly-coupled condensates with negative scattering length. The condensates are trapped in a double-well potential and elongated in one dimension.

arxiv-2112-12900.title: Global Existence and Large Time Behaviors of Strong Solutions to the Kinetic Cucker–Smale Model Coupled with the Three Dimensional Incompressible Navier–Stokes Equations Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification: 35A01, 35B45, 35D35, 35Q35, 35Q92
arxiv-2112-12900.creator: Chunyin Jin
arxiv-2112-12900.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study global existence and large time behaviors of strong solutions to the kinetic Cucker–Smale model coupled with the three dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes equations in the whole space. Using the maximal regularity estimate on the Stokes equations, global-in-time strong solutions to the Cauchy problem of the coupled system are obtained under small initial data regime.

arxiv-2209-12583.title: Momentum transfer in the dark sector and lensing convergence in upcoming galaxy surveys
arxiv-2209-12583.creator: David Figueruelo
arxiv-2209-12583.description: Abstract We investigated a cosmological model that allows a momentum transfer between dark matter and dark energy. The interaction in the dark sector mainly affects the behaviour of perturbations on small scales while the background evolution matches the w w CDM solution.

arxiv-2210-00010.title: A revised energy formalism for common-envelope evolution: repercussions for planetary engulfment and the formation of neutron star binaries GNU Scientific Library 2.7 ( Galassi et al. 2009 ) , HDF5 ( The HDF Group 1997-NNNN ) , matplotlib 3.6.0 ( Hunter 2007 ) , MESA r22.05.1 ( Fuller et al. 1985 ;
arxiv-2210-00010.creator: Ricardo Yarza, Rosa Wallace Everson, Enrico Ramirez-Ruiz
arxiv-2210-00010.description: Abstract Common-envelope evolution is a stage in binary system evolution in which a giant star engulfs a companion. The standard energy formalism is an analytical framework to estimate the amount of energy transferred from the companion’s shrinking orbit into the envelope of the star that engulfed it.

arxiv-2301-09371.title: Understanding the Frequency Dependence of Capacitance Measurements of Irradiated Silicon Detectors
arxiv-2301-09371.creator: Sven Mägdefessel, Riccardo Mori, Niels Sorgenfrei, Ulrich Parzefall
arxiv-2301-09371.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Capacitance-voltage (CV) measurements are a widely used technique in silicon detector physics. By increasing the reverse bias voltage while scanning the capacitance, it is possible to derive crucial parameters like the full depletion voltage or the doping concentration. However, this only works if the sensor is not too heavily irradiated.

arxiv-2512-17525.title: Computational analysis reveals historical trajectory of East-Polynesian lunar calendars
arxiv-2512-17525.creator: Miguel Valério
arxiv-2512-17525.description: Abstract We investigate a type of lunar calendar known as lists of the ’nights of the moon’, found throughout East Polynesia, including Rapa Nui (Easter Island). Using computational methods, we analyzed the lexical and structural divergence of 49 calendric lists from all major archipelagos, each containing about 30 night names.

arxiv-2601-22489.title: Structural Conditions for Native CCZ Magic-State Fountains in qLDPC Codes
arxiv-2601-22489.creator: Mohammad Rowshan
arxiv-2601-22489.description: Abstract Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes promise constant-rate, linear-distance families with bounded-weight checks, and recent work has realized transversal or constant-depth non-Clifford gates on various (often non-LDPC) codes. However, no explicit qubit qLDPC family is known that simultaneously has constant rate, linear distance, bounded stabilizer weight, and a native magic-state fountain that prepares many non-Clifford resource states in constant depth.

arxiv-2602-10739.title: Equity by Design: Fairness-Driven Recommendation in Heterogeneous Two-Sided Markets DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: SIGIR ’26; July 20–24, 2026; Melbourne, Australia ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2026/06
arxiv-2602-10739.creator: Dominykas Seputis, Alexander Timans, Rajeev Verma
arxiv-2602-10739.description: Abstract . Two-sided marketplaces embody heterogeneity in incentives: producers seek exposure while consumers seek relevance, and balancing these competing objectives through constrained optimization is now a standard practice. Yet real platforms face finer-grained complexity: consumers differ in preferences and engagement patterns, producers vary in catalog value and capacity, and business objectives impose additional constraints beyond raw relevance.

arxiv-2602-17367.title: A Collective Trigger for Widespread Planetesimal Formation Revealed by Accretion Ages Journal: Earth and Planetary Science Letters
arxiv-2602-17367.creator: James F J Bryson, Hannah R Sanderson, Francis Nimmo, Sanjana Sridhar, Gregory A Brennecka, Yves Marrocchi, Jason P Terry
arxiv-2602-17367.description: Abstract The formation of planetesimals was an integral part of the cascading series of processes that built the terrestrial planets. To illuminate planetesimal formation, here we develop a refined thermal evolution model to calculate the formation ages of meteorite parent planetesimals.

britannica-1911-atherstone.title: Atherstone (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-atherstone.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-atherstone.description: Article 'Atherstone' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Atherstone (Aderestone, Edridestone, Edrichestone), though not mentioned in any pre-Conquest record, is of unquestionably ancient origin. A Saxon barrow was opened near the town in 1824. It is traversed by Watling Street, and portions of the ancient Roman road have been discovered in modern times. Atherstone is mentioned in Domesday among the possessions of Countess Godiva, the widow of Leofric.

pmc-10669139.creator: Xiaoqing Lin, Runkai Jiao, Feifei Li, Di Lu, Hang Yin, Xintong Jiang
pmc-10669139.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Job crafting is an important concept associated with many positive outcomes, particularly for kindergarten teachers. pmc-11561647.creator: John Sturgis, Rupesh Singh, Quinn R Caron, Ivy S Samuels, Thomas Micheal Shiju, Aditi Mukkara, Paul Freedman, Vera L Bonilha
pmc-11561647.description: Somatic mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutation accumulation has been observed in individuals with retinal degenerative disorders. POLG is an enzyme responsible for regulating mtDNA replication and repair.
